info.title: SMSGlobal Universal API
info.description: Send SMSGlobal messages and manage contacts, groups, and account settings

get.description: Retrieves auto top-up settings for the SMSGlobal account.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.
